name: ping_hosts
description: Check if a list of hosts answers ping (cmd_path + params_map example).
help:
Ping each host and print OK or FAIL.

This command runs a script file (cmd_path). Short flags are mapped to the script's long flags with params_map.

Aliases:
ph

Parameters:
- Use -hl/--hosts to pass a comma separated host list (default: 1.1.1.1,example.com).
- Use -c/--count to set how many pings per host (default: 1).

Examples:
cy ping_hosts
cy ph -c 3 -hl 1.1.1.1,8.8.8.8,example.com
